gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep

forms.label: ている past polite

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep
definitions.explanation: To transition from being awake to being asleep.

definitions.gloss: to take root, to become established
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe a habit, custom, or idea becoming firmly established.

notes:
{寝付|ねつ}く is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to fall asleep.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep) + ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to attach, to settle) → to settle into sleep

ASPECT (ている):
{寝付|ねつ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being asleep (having fallen asleep).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{寝付|ねつ}けない (can't fall asleep easily)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{寝付|ねつ}いた (finally fell asleep)
- {寝付|ねつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (easy/hard to fall asleep)
- ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧{寝付|ねつ}く (fall asleep quickly)

RELATED NOUN:
- {寝付|ねつ}き: the ability to fall asleep; {寝付|ねつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ = falls asleep easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep (more general)
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to go to bed, to sleep
- {寝付|ねつ}く specifically refers to the act of falling asleep
